title: ADR-0055: mark the 2026-11-07 chain clause for writeRequiresMasterRead, and narrow "answers deny for all of them" to a stored row
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRxXmVQ41fqnaTPGAv

Filing gate: ① (follow-ups named by reviews of work in flight: F2 of the at-tier contract review 6899080787 on PR #34075, card #33432; and nit 6 of the at-tier review 6886893250 on PR #33425, which no card carries — #33432 took nits 1 to 5 only). Both are outside PR #34075's claimed edits. Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open ADR-0055 chain writeRequiresMasterRead`: only #33432.

Blocked-by: #33432 (PR #34075, same file; serial).

## 维护者速读

- 内容:只改 ADR-0055 两处措辞,不改代码。① 2026-11-07 状态行与正文 Chains 条说「主记录为空的链上一跳按该行的属主规则结束链」;在声明了 `writeRequiresMasterRead` 的子对象那一跳,链在问主记录读权后就结束,不再看那一跳的属主规则,这两处还没加注。② 「`checkControlledByParentWrite` answers `deny` for all of them」:该成员只问已存的记录,新增和改挂主记录的请求体问不到它,应收窄为「对这类调用者的已存记录」。
- ADR 属受管文件,需要您亲手合并。

## What to write

On `main` (after PR #34075 lands, re-read every line number):

1. **F2.** The 2026-11-07 status line's clause "a chain hop with no master of its own ends the chain under the same rule", and the 2026-11-07 body's **Chains** bullet ("A hop whose master is itself `controlled_by_parent` with an optional master of its own, left empty, ends the chain there and asks that row's owner rule"). On a hop whose detail declares `writeRequiresMasterRead`, `security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts#assertControlledByParentChainEditable` asks read on that master row and `break`s before it looks at that row's own reference, so the owner rule is not asked there. Add one in-place ⚠️ clause at each spot, in the form PR #34075 used for the same status line; do not rewrite the old text.
2. **Nit 6 of 6886893250.** In "What a refusal answers" (2026-11-14 amendment): "`ISecurityService.checkControlledByParentWrite` answers `deny` for all of them". The member's signature is `(object, recordId, context)`: it answers the by-id cases only; an insert or a re-point body cannot be put to it. Narrow it to "for a stored row of such a caller" (insert-only edit if it can be done that way; otherwise the smallest replacement, kept on the record in the PR body).
3. Leave the `**Status**:` line, ADR-0139 and every other section alone. No code, no test, no changeset (`skip-changeset`). Gates: the ADR registry, index and anchor checks `dispatch-gates --commands` derives.

## Reader

`domain:skills` (`docs/adr/**` is governed: maintainer merge, Tier H). Size XS. Same class as #33432.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
